cases.title: A working switch can still be unsafe
cases.summary: The keyboard fix works, but new low-contrast text causes rejection.
cases.problem: One Space press toggles the original switch twice, leaving its value unchanged.
cases.repairExplanation: The patch makes the switch respond once to keyboard activation. Its new styling also makes the Off label too faint.
cases.decisionExplanation: Keyboard tasks improve from 0/2 to 2/2, but the new Off label has 1.19:1 contrast against a required 4.5:1. The candidate is rejected.

cases.title: Keyboard play is only part of the proof
cases.summary: Keyboard play improves, but unresolved checks and lost board outlines prevent acceptance.
cases.problem: The public React mini app has clickable game cells that keyboard users cannot operate.
cases.repairExplanation: The patch makes cells keyboard-operable. Screenshot review also found that the board outlines disappeared.
cases.decisionExplanation: The frozen verifier rejects 16 new incomplete signatures, not 16 confirmed violations. A separate screenshot review found missing board outlines that the task checks missed.
